Formula: COUNT(searches with >= 1 PDP click where tokens >= 4 and existing results < 3) / COUNT(eligible searches)
Target_Direction: Positive Lift (+3.0 to +4.0 pp target, p < 0.05)
Strategic_Rationale: Direct behavioral measure of whether relaxed results successfully surface clickable, relevant inventory to high-intent shoppers experiencing discovery failure.

Formula: COUNT(searches with >= 1 PDP click where tokens >= 4) / COUNT(total 4+ token searches)
Strategic_Rationale: Monitors the entire specific-query population to ensure overall discoverability and Intent-to-Treat (ITT) health are preserved.

Formula: COUNT(searches with results_count = 0 and tokens >= 4) / COUNT(total 4+ token searches)
Strategic_Rationale: Measures reduction of catastrophic discovery failure dead-ends where shoppers see completely empty product grids.

Formula: COUNT(DISTINCT search sessions with >= 1 cart_event) / COUNT(total search sessions)
Strategic_Rationale: Validates that PDP clicks generated by query relaxation represent genuine purchase consideration, not hollow clicks.

Formula: COUNT(DISTINCT 4+ token search sessions with completed order) / COUNT(total 4+ token search sessions)
Strategic_Rationale: End-to-end commercial impact; confirms that discovery recovery flows through checkout to realized GMV.

Formula: COUNT(4+ token searches followed by another query in same session) / COUNT(total 4+ token searches)
Strategic_Rationale: Reflects reduction in user cognitive friction and manual re-typing fatigue.

Formula: 95th percentile of server-side search_latency_ms across all queries
Baseline_Value: Proposed SLA target: < 250 ms (Fallback overhead budget < 40 ms)
Strategic_Rationale: Proposed non-functional requirement to protect user experience against slow search rendering.

Formula: COUNT(1-3 token searches with >= 1 PDP click) / COUNT(total 1-3 token searches)
Strategic_Rationale: Ensures relaxation logic does not accidentally cannibalize high-converting head query performance.

Formula: COUNT(search sessions with exactly 1 search and 0 downstream events) / COUNT(total search sessions)
Strategic_Rationale: Protects against serving irrelevant junk results that cause immediate shopper abandonment.

Formula: COUNT(PDP clicks with view_duration < 5 seconds) / COUNT(total PDP clicks)
Strategic_Rationale: Key relevance safety check; ensures users do not bounce immediately upon discovering relaxed product mismatch.
Confirms the intervention protects top-line financial health and average order value.
